{{Quote|The Iesei shall rejoice. She offers dancing and membrosia; the chance to walk the tunnels of the Synapse-Comb.|Daizanna|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Synapse-Comb''' was a place affiliated with the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Iesei]] hive. When during the [[Galactic War]] the Iesei held a celebration for re-uniting with the [[Oroboro]] hive of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] which they thought lost, [[Daizanna]] mentioned the Synapse-Comb as a place not everyone would get a chance to visit.
